description: This file defines a REST controller for managing customer data in a banking application, using Spring Web annotations to map HTTP endpoints related to customer CRUD operations.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: Spring REST controller handling HTTP requests for customer management, supporting CRUD operations via mappings such as /all, /add, /{customerNumber}

methods.name: getAllCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of all customers.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new customer, expects CustomerDetails object in request body.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific customer by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update customer details for a specific customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a customer by customer number.
